resources.string: Grow your focus. Reclaim your time.

Focus Forest can read Android foreground app usage totals and launchable app names so you can choose specific apps to monitor, view daily habits, and compare completed days. This permission is completely optional—focus sessions, challenges, and your forest work without it. All usage data remains strictly in local device storage, is never uploaded or shared with analytics or ads, and can be paused or permanently deleted anytime in Settings.
Gentle alerts when a focus session finishes.
Optional, respectful reminders for your daily focus goal and weekly summary.
